author_scope.title: 通用通信系统模型
author_scope.takeaway: 任何通信系统均可抽象为五部分：信源、发送器、信道、接收器、目的地，并受噪声源干扰。该模型统一了电报、电话、电视等离散与连续系统。
author_scope.interaction: 点击模型中的不同组件（如‘发送器’），高亮显示原文中对应的具体实例（如 PCM 编码、声压变电流），并在侧边栏展示 Fig. 1 的结构图。
author_scope.changes: 用户选择不同应用场景（电报/电话/电视），界面展示信源产生的消息形式变化（字母序列/时间函数/时空函数）。
author_scope.acceptance: 用户能指出噪声源在模型中的位置（作用于信道到接收器的路径），并区分‘消息’与‘信号’。

art_direction: 宿主为浅色研究工作台。作品内部采用‘深蓝墨水’风格：主色调为深海军蓝（#1a2b4a）与炭灰，强调色为电光蓝（#007acc）用于高亮关键变量。版式摒弃网格卡片，采用‘手稿推导流’布局：左侧为逻辑叙述，右侧动态浮现对应的数学推导、状态转移图或信号波形。字体选用衬线体（如 Source Serif Pro）以呼应 1948 年原稿质感，公式使用 LaTeX 渲染。交互区域采用半透明磨砂玻璃效果，避免遮挡背景中的核心论证流。
shared_design: 遵循整篇art_direction，自选适合材料的机制图、证据比较或论证关系。宿主提供基础字体、按钮和间距，CSS写本章构图，不用重复卡片网格。

nodes.title: 通用通信系统模型
nodes.summary: 香农提出了一个包含五个基本部分的通用通信系统 schematic 模型：信源、发送器、信道、接收器和目的地。此外，噪声源作为一个干扰因素被引入，影响信道中的信号。该模型旨在涵盖离散、连续及混合系统。
paragraphs: 通用通信系统被抽象为五个核心部分。首先是信源（Information Source），产生待传输的消息，消息形式可以是字母序列（电报）、时间函数（电话）、时空函数（电视）或多路复用信号。
其次是发送器（Transmitter），它对消息进行操作以生成适合信道传输的信号。例如在电话中将声压变为电流，或在电报中进行编码。第三是信道（Channel），即传输信号的介质，如导线、无线电频段或光束。
第四是接收器（Receiver），通常执行与发送器相反的操作，从信号中重构消息。最后是目的地（Destination），即消息的 intended 接收者（人或物）。
图中还特别标出了噪声源（Noise Source），它代表在信道传输过程中可能加入的干扰。香农指出，为了进行数学分析，这些物理组件需要被理想化为数学实体。系统可分为离散、连续和混合三类。
注意：原文图 1（Fig. 1）展示了这些组件的连接关系，其中噪声源直接作用于信道到接收器的路径上。

S005.quote: HE recent development of various methods of modulation such as PCM and PPM which exchange

S006.quote:
bandwidth for signal-to-noise ratio has intensiﬁed the interest in a general theory of communication. A
basis for such a theory is contained in the important papers of Nyquist1 and Hartley2 on this subject. In the
present paper we will extend the theory to include a number of new factors, in particular the effect of noise
in the channel, and the savings possible due to the statistical structure of the original message and due to the
nature of the ﬁnal destination of the information.

S007.quote:
The fundamental problem of communication is that of reproducing at one point either exactly or ap-
proximately a message selected at another point. Frequently the messages have meaning; that is they refer
to or are correlated according to some system with certain physical or conceptual entities. These semantic
aspects of communication are irrelevant to the engineering problem. The signiﬁcant aspect is that the actual
message is one selected from a set of possible messages. The system must be designed to operate for each
possible selection, not just the one which will actually be chosen since this is unknown at the time of design.

S008.quote:
If the number of messages in the set is ﬁnite then this number or any monotonic function of this number
can be regarded as a measure of the information produced when one message is chosen from the set, all
choices being equally likely. As was pointed out by Hartley the most natural choice is the logarithmic
function. Although this deﬁnition must be generalized considerably when we consider the inﬂuence of the
statistics of the message and when we have a continuous range of messages, we will in all cases use an
essentially logarithmic measure.

S009.quote: The logarithmic measure is more convenient for various reasons:

S010.quote:
1. It is practically more useful. Parameters of engineering importance such as time, bandwidth, number
of relays, etc., tend to vary linearly with the logarithm of the number of possibilities. For example,
adding one relay to a group doubles the number of possible states of the relays. It adds 1 to the base 2
logarithm of this number. Doubling the time roughly squares the number of possible messages, or
doubles the logarithm, etc.

S011.quote:
2. It is nearer to our intuitive feeling as to the proper measure. This is closely related to (1) since we in-
tuitively measures entities by linear comparison with common standards. One feels, for example, that
two punched cards should have twice the capacity of one for information storage, and two identical
channels twice the capacity of one for transmitting information.

S012.quote:
3. It is mathematically more suitable. Many of the limiting operations are simple in terms of the loga-
rithm but would require clumsy restatement in terms of the number of possibilities.

S013.quote:

base 2 is used the resulting units may be called binary digits, or more brieﬂy bits, a word suggested by
J. W. Tukey. A device with two stable positions, such as a relay or a ﬂip-ﬂop circuit, can store one bit of
information. N such devices can store N bits, since the total number of possible states is 2N and log2 2N

necessary to represent the various elements involved as mathematical entities, suitably idealized from their

continuous and mixed. By a discrete system we will mean one in which both the message and the signal

and the signal a sequence of dots, dashes and spaces. A continuous system is one in which the message and
signal are both treated as continuous functions, e.g., radio or television. A mixed system is one in which
both discrete and continuous variables appear, e.g., PCM transmission of speech.

S076.quote:
We have seen that under very general conditions the logarithm of the number of possible signals in a discrete
channel increases linearly with time. The capacity to transmit information can be speciﬁed by giving this
rate of increase, the number of bits per second required to specify the particular signal used.

S077.quote:
We now consider the information source. How is an information source to be described mathematically,
and how much information in bits per second is produced in a given source? The main point at issue is the
effect of statistical knowledge about the source in reducing the required capacity of the channel, by the use

S078.quote:
of proper encoding of the information. In telegraphy, for example, the messages to be transmitted consist of
sequences of letters. These sequences, however, are not completely random. In general, they form sentences
and have the statistical structure of, say, English. The letter E occurs more frequently than Q, the sequence
TH more frequently than XP, etc. The existence of this structure allows one to make a saving in time (or
channel capacity) by properly encoding the message sequences into signal sequences. This is already done
to a limited extent in telegraphy by using the shortest channel symbol, a dot, for the most common English
letter E; while the infrequent letters, Q, X, Z are represented by longer sequences of dots and dashes. This
idea is carried still further in certain commercial codes where common words and phrases are represented
by four- or ﬁve-letter code groups with a considerable saving in average time. The standardized greeting
and anniversary telegrams now in use extend this to the point of encoding a sentence or two into a relatively
short sequence of numbers.

S1100.quote: PART V: THE RATE FOR A CONTINUOUS SOURCE

S1102.quote:
In the case of a discrete source of information we were able to determine a deﬁnite rate of generating
information, namely the entropy of the underlying stochastic process. With a continuous source the situation
is considerably more involved. In the ﬁrst place a continuously variable quantity can assume an inﬁnite
number of values and requires, therefore, an inﬁnite number of binary digits for exact speciﬁcation. This
means that to transmit the output of a continuous source with exact recovery at the receiving point requires,

S1103.quote:
in general, a channel of inﬁnite capacity (in bits per second). Since, ordinarily, channels have a certain
amount of noise, and therefore a ﬁnite capacity, exact transmission is impossible.

S1104.quote:
This, however, evades the real issue. Practically, we are not interested in exact transmission when we
have a continuous source, but only in transmission to within a certain tolerance. The question is, can we
assign a deﬁnite rate to a continuous source when we require only a certain ﬁdelity of recovery, measured in
a suitable way. Of course, as the ﬁdelity requirements are increased the rate will increase. It will be shown
that we can, in very general cases, deﬁne such a rate, having the property that it is possible, by properly
encoding the information, to transmit it over a channel whose capacity is equal to the rate in question, and
satisfy the ﬁdelity requirements. A channel of smaller capacity is insufﬁcient.

concept-4a0c1a354843a45f.title: 语义无关性 (Semantic Irrelevance)
concept-4a0c1a354843a45f.lead: 工程视角下的信息定义边界
concept-4a0c1a354843a45f.text: 在香农的理论框架中，消息的具体含义（即它指代什么物理或概念实体）被视为与通信系统的工程设计无关。系统只关心从集合中选择了一个特定的消息，并需要传输这个选择。
concept-4a0c1a354843a45f.why: 这是信息论区别于语义学或语用学的核心假设，使得信息可以被量化为纯粹的统计或结构属性。

concept-cd1c5ab91a50cc55.title: 比特 (Bit)
concept-cd1c5ab91a50cc55.text: Binary digit 的缩写，由 J. W. Tukey 建议。定义为以 2 为底的对数单位。一个具有两个稳定位置（如继电器的开/关）的设备可以存储 1 比特信息。
concept-cd1c5ab91a50cc55.why: 它是连接物理设备状态数量与信息量的桥梁，使得工程参数（如继电器数量）能与信息量进行线性计算。

concept-fd1192c981a4ac01.title: 发送器操作 (Transmitter Operation)
concept-fd1192c981a4ac01.lead: 消息到信号的转换机制
concept-fd1192c981a4ac01.text: 发送器的作用是对消息进行处理，使其适合在特定信道上传输。这可能包括简单的物理转换（如声压变电流）或复杂的编码、采样、量化和多路复用（如 PCM 系统）。
concept-fd1192c981a4ac01.why: 理解发送器的功能有助于区分“消息”（原始信息）与“信号”（物理传输形式），这是分析信道容量的前提。

concept-cefe311e8d0e9789.title: 离散与连续系统 (Discrete vs. Continuous Systems)
concept-cefe311e8d0e9789.text: 离散系统中消息和信号均为离散符号序列（如电报）；连续系统中两者均为连续函数（如无线电）；混合系统则兼具两者（如语音的 PCM 传输）。
concept-cefe311e8d0e9789.why: 这种分类决定了后续数学工具的选择（差分方程 vs 微积分），香农在文中首先处理离散无噪情况作为基础。

concept-037b2dea3b429e44.title: 信道容量 (Channel Capacity)
concept-037b2dea3b429e44.lead: 离散无噪信道的极限传输速率
concept-037b2dea3b429e44.text: 在给定的离散无噪信道中，单位时间内能传输的最大信息量（比特数）。数学上定义为允许信号数量对数随时间增长的渐近速率。
concept-037b2dea3b429e44.why: 它是衡量信道传输能力的理论上限，实际传输速率不能超过此值，但可以通过编码逼近此值。

concept-4e10b4480f8838da.title: 特征方程 (Characteristic Equation)
concept-4e10b4480f8838da.lead: 求解差分方程渐近行为的关键
concept-4e10b4480f8838da.text: 由信道符号时长和约束导出的代数方程。其最大实根决定了允许信号数量 N(T) 随时间 T 指数增长的底数。
concept-4e10b4480f8838da.why: 它将复杂的组合计数问题转化为代数求根问题，使得容量计算成为可能。

concept-d11fa986c1cbf8b4.title: 遍历过程 (Ergodic Process)
concept-d11fa986c1cbf8b4.lead: 统计齐同性的数学描述
concept-d11fa986c1cbf8b4.text: 指一种随机过程，其中单个足够长的样本序列的统计特性（如时间平均）等同于所有可能序列的系综平均。在通信中，这意味着无论观察到哪一段长消息，其字母频率和结构特征都代表了信源的整体特性。
concept-d11fa986c1cbf8b4.why: 这是定义信源熵作为确定值的前提条件，确保了统计测量的稳定性。

concept-0d12510deca343fc.title: 马尔可夫过程 (Markoff Process)
concept-0d12510deca343fc.lead: 具有记忆性的符号生成机制
concept-0d12510deca343fc.text: 一种随机过程，其中下一个状态（或符号）的概率仅取决于当前状态（或前有限个状态），而与更早的历史无关。香农用它来模拟自然语言中字母间的依赖关系（如双字母、三字母频率）。
concept-0d12510deca343fc.why: 它是构建离散信源数学模型的核心工具，使得复杂的语言结构可以被量化分析。

concept-b583805b77d8a8b5.title: 典型序列 (Typical Sequence)
concept-b583805b77d8a8b5.text: 在长序列极限下，那些出现概率接近 $2^{-NH}$ 的序列集合。虽然单个典型序列的概率很小，但所有典型序列的总概率趋近于 1，且其数量约为 $2^{NH}$。这是香农第一定理证明的关键概念。
concept-b583805b77d8a8b5.why: 它允许我们将无限多的可能序列简化为一个大小可控的高概率子集进行编码，从而实现接近熵率的压缩。

concept-5586eaf37709bc0b.title: 冗余 (Redundancy)
concept-5586eaf37709bc0b.lead: 信源实际熵与最大可能熵的差值比例
concept-5586eaf37709bc0b.text: 定义为 $1$ 减去相对熵（Relative Entropy）。相对熵是信源熵与同样符号集下最大熵（即等概独立分布时的熵）的比值。冗余反映了信源中由于统计结构（如字母频率不均、相关性）而可以被压缩的部分。
concept-5586eaf37709bc0b.why: 冗余的存在意味着信源未被充分利用，通过编码去除冗余可以提高传输效率，使其接近信道容量。

concept-53454feb4efa20c7.title: 模糊度 (Equivocation)
concept-53454feb4efa20c7.lead: 接收端的剩余不确定性
concept-53454feb4efa20c7.text: 条件熵 $H_y(x)$ 的别称，表示在接收到信号 $y$ 后，关于原始发送信号 $x$ 仍然存在的平均不确定性。它量化了噪声对信息传输的破坏程度。
concept-53454feb4efa20c7.why: 它是定义含噪信道有效传输速率和容量的核心变量，直接反映了信道的可靠性损失。

concept-b6d34740cb2800bd.title: 信道容量 (Channel Capacity, Noisy)
concept-b6d34740cb2800bd.lead: 含噪信道的最大可靠传输速率
concept-b6d34740cb2800bd.text: 定义为 $C = \text{max}_{p(x)} [H(x) - H_y(x)]$。它表示在最佳输入分布下，信道每秒钟能够无差错（或错误率任意小）传输的最大信息量（比特数）。
concept-b6d34740cb2800bd.why: 这是通信系统设计的终极目标，区分了“可实现”与“不可实现”的传输速率区域。

concept-5df82cfeadc8d848.title: 熵功率 (Entropy Power)
concept-5df82cfeadc8d848.lead: 一种将任意分布的熵转换为等效白噪声功率的不变量。
concept-5df82cfeadc8d848.text: 熵功率 N' 定义为 N' = (1/2πe) * exp(2H)，其中 H 为微分熵。它表示如果一个白噪声过程具有与该过程相同的熵，该白噪声所具有的功率。
concept-5df82cfeadc8d848.why: 用于消除连续熵对坐标系的依赖性，使得不同分布的信息含量可以在功率维度上进行公平比较。

concept-a82f8a257eb24dbf.title: 微分熵 (Differential Entropy)
concept-a82f8a257eb24dbf.lead: 连续随机变量不确定性的度量，形式上类比离散熵但使用积分。
concept-a82f8a257eb24dbf.text: 定义为 H(X) = -∫ p(x) log p(x) dx。与离散熵不同，它可以是负数，且随坐标缩放而变化。
concept-a82f8a257eb24dbf.why: 是处理连续信号通信理论的基础数学工具，尽管其绝对值无物理意义，但其差值（如互信息）具有物理意义。

concept-7ea2f21fed41ec17.title: 连续信道容量
concept-7ea2f21fed41ec17.lead: 在存在噪声和功率限制的情况下，信道每秒钟能可靠传输的最大比特数。
concept-7ea2f21fed41ec17.text: 对于加性高斯白噪声信道，容量由带宽和信噪比决定。它是一个理论上限，实际系统只能逼近而无法超越。
concept-7ea2f21fed41ec17.why: 确立了通信系统性能的根本极限，指导了编码和调制技术的发展方向。

concept-06b76ca69d49e3ee.title: 保真度评价函数
concept-06b76ca69d49e3ee.lead: 用于量化重建消息与原始消息之间差异的数学函数。
concept-06b76ca69d49e3ee.text: 通常定义为距离函数 ρ(x;y) 关于联合概率分布 P(x;y) 的期望值。它反映了应用层面对失真的容忍程度，如均方误差或听觉 intelligibility。
concept-06b76ca69d49e3ee.why: 将主观的“质量”要求转化为可优化的数学约束，是定义连续信源率的前提。

concept-372ccf61cd9543fe.title: 率失真函数 (Rate-Distortion Function)
concept-372ccf61cd9543fe.lead: 描述在给定失真水平下，信源压缩所需的最低比特率。
concept-372ccf61cd9543fe.text: R(D) 是互信息 I(X;Y) 的下确界，约束条件为平均失真 E[d(X,Y)] ≤ D。它是信源本身的属性，与具体信道无关。
concept-372ccf61cd9543fe.why: 提供了有损压缩的理论极限，说明了为了获得多少失真可以节省多少带宽。

concept-fb9e6d77307bd014.title: 峰值功率限制 (Peak Power Limitation)
concept-fb9e6d77307bd014.lead: 一种对发射信号瞬时幅度的硬性约束。
concept-fb9e6d77307bd014.text: 指发射机输出的信号波形 f(t) 在任何时间瞬间的绝对值都不能超过给定的阈值 S。这与平均功率限制（一段时间内的能量平均值）不同，它对信号的动态范围提出了更严格的要求。
concept-fb9e6d77307bd014.why: 理解此概念是区分本节内容与经典香农公式（基于平均功率）的关键，它导致了数学处理上的复杂性和界限解的出现。

concept-c066239c86b5930a.title: 渐近上界 (Asymptotic Upper Bound)
concept-c066239c86b5930a.lead: 在参数趋向极限时有效的容量上限估计。
concept-c066239c86b5930a.text: 在峰值功率 S 趋向无穷大（或信噪比极大）的条件下推导出的容量上限。Shannon 通过放宽约束条件（仅在采样点限制功率）来获得这个界，并证明随着 S 增大，该界与实际容量的差距（由 ε 表示）趋于零。
concept-c066239c86b5930a.why: 由于无法获得精确解，渐近上界提供了在大信号条件下对系统性能的理论极限认知，是评估实际编码方案效率的基准。
